prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: []
1: ["Create Your Custom Desktop Pet", "Upload Photo"]
2: ["Preparing desktop asset files and setting up companion animations...", "Estimated Time Remaining"]
3: ["Sign In & Restore Your Desktop Companions", "Log in to sync your saved pets, custom outfits, and progress safely across devices.", "Sign In with Account", "Cloud Backup Enabled"]
4: ["Next: Learn Controls"]
5: ["Tip: You can change your companion's path and personality traits anytime in settings later.", "Flexible Choice"]
6: ["We will send a system desktop notification as soon as your pet is ready to join your desktop.", "Notify Me When Ready"]
7: ["Welcome Your New Companion Home", "Give your pet a unique name to receive a personalized adoption badge on your desktop.", "Personalized Companion Badge"]
8: ["Discover Your Desktop Companion's World"]
9: ["Your Desktop Pet is Active!", "Look for the pet icon in your system tray to access quick settings, talk options, or hide your companion anytime.", "Right-click the tray icon to open controls or adjust desktop overlay settings."]
